blocks.text: DETROIT — Paul George looks like he’s still got it. He scored 38 points — the most by a Boston Celtic in his debut, and the fifth-most by a player in his first game with an NBA franchise — in a 121-113 collapsing defeat Tuesday. “I’m not a moral victory guy,” George said after making 12 of 21 shots, including 7 of 12 3-pointers. “It means nothing.” READ: NBA: Pistons rally past Celtics as new season tips off Maybe not, but the nine-time All-Star was impressive and earned a spot in rarefied air, The NBA scoring record for a debut was […]...
